hypotheses.hypothesis: Blending each coin's tsmom z-score 50/50 with Bitcoin's (the crypto market factor, read one bar late) improves portfolio excess Sharpe over own-series tsmom, because an alt's own 15-day return is a noisy reading of the market-wide trend that trend following actually captures (factor momentum, Ehsani & Linnainmaa 2022). Signal-level measurement on 2017-2023 dev data preceded this registration (experiments/factor_trend/). Parameters are tsmom's live defaults (90/30/0.5 sigma); factorWeight=0.5 was fixed by prior as the agnostic equal weight before the 2017+ table was seen.
